en.headline: Loop Hong Kong Park second land tender draws nine bids
en.dek: The operator said frontier technology firms and major conglomerates submitted offers for three laboratory and office parcels in the first phase.
body: Loop Hong Kong Park Company, which operates the Hong Kong-Shenzhen Innovation and Technology Park, said on Tuesday that its second batch of Phase 1 land parcels had drawn nine bids.

The tender covered three land parcels mainly for laboratory and office use. One parcel is eligible to be paired with a talent-accommodation site. The company said participating bidders included frontier technology enterprises, firms with park operation experience, and major conglomerates.

Results of the first two tender rounds are expected to be announced by the end of the year. The first round in late August received six bids for four parcels. The company said the response reaffirmed industry confidence in the park’s future and that it would continue releasing land in an orderly manner.

zh.headline: 河套香港園區第二批土地招標接獲九份標書
zh.dek: 園區公司表示，投標者包括前沿科技企業及大型綜合企業，涉及三幅主要作實驗室及辦公室用途的第一期地塊。
body: 港深創新及科技園有限公司周二表示，河套香港園區第一期第二批土地招標共接獲九份標書。
是次招標涵蓋三幅主要作實驗室及辦公室用途的創科用地，其中一幅可選擇配對人才公寓用地。公司指參與投標者包括前沿科技企業、具備園區營運經驗的企業及大型綜合企業。
首兩輪招標結果預計於年底公布。八月底首輪招標四幅地塊接獲六份標書。公司表示反應再證業界對園區未來的信心，並會繼續有序推出土地。
